newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close up on retail interest.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close up on retail interest.

text.p: Dhaka stocks closed up marginally on Monday on gains by mainly blue chips in engineering, pharmaceutical and cement sectors, brokers said.
The Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) all-share price index closed up 11.14 points or 0.06 percent at 1870.97 on a turnover of 54.2 million taka. Of 88 traded issues, 50 gained and 30 lost.
United Leasing Company lost 56 taka to 1,911, Beximco Pharma gained 6.0 to 194 and Bata Shoe was up 7.0 to 168.
